name: Simple overall heat score (one mark per rider per judge)
description: Judges do not score individual tricks. Each judge gives one 0-10 mark per rider for the whole heat; marks are averaged. Ideal for club heats, kids' divisions or when only one or two judges are available. Spotter logging is optional and purely informational.
basedOn: Common club-heat practice (single overall mark per rider from each judge)

impression.label: Heat score
impression.help: Overall impression of the rider's heat: height, extremity, variety, technicality, execution and landings.
